# Frigidaire Portable Air Conditioner

> **Status**: Spec available
> **Protocol**: WiFi
> **Manufacturer**: Frigidaire (Electrolux)

## Overview

Portable Frigidaire air conditioner with WiFi connectivity. Controlled through the
Electrolux cloud platform.

Machine-readable spec: `device-specs/devices/frigidaire-portable-ac.yaml`.

Home Assistant: [bm1549/home-assistant-frigidaire](https://github.com/bm1549/home-assistant-frigidaire) (HACS) covers these ACs via the Electrolux cloud API.

See also the combined [Frigidaire overview page](frigidaire-ac.md).
